name: mirage
text:
Not on purpose and not a matching fault: ParlayAPI's stream was switched off, so it was barely reading.

- In the 18:08 UTC scan ParlayAPI answered only 2 feed reads and its odds stream said 'off'. That was the same cause as your first question: the tablet's default settings had the sockets off.
- I switched the stream on at 18:14. In the next scan it was live (16 connections, 20,394 sides held, 40 books) and its reads went up to 8, 3 and 5 across games, 1st halves and props. It supplied 36,874 priced game lines and 52,936 prop lines in that scan.
- Where PropLine and ParlayAPI quote the same book and line, PropLine usually wins the tie (it is the first source), so you often see PropLine's name where ParlayAPI also agrees. ParlayAPI mostly shows up for Pinnacle's props and team totals.
- One caveat: its credit key status reads 'free plan, 54 left', so I'll watch whether the Business key is the one in use. The engine's advice line still says most of the paid credits are left.

I'll recheck in a few scans whether bets list ParlayAPI as a source.
